title: Spectral bounds and their limits in Pauli contextuality: exact configurations and a proof of Jonah's Conjecture E

author.name: Alexander S. Donahue
author.orcid_provenance: Supplied by the author; matching public record and authenticated ORCID editor observed, displaying Alexander Donahue and identifier 0009-0006-8168-9648. No independent legal-identity certification.

destinations: Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and Theoretical
abstract:
Spectral methods give rigorous bounds on Pauli contextuality, yet a spectrum need not retain the
information needed by a related completion problem.
For $N$ qubits, $D=2^N$, and any set $S$ of nonidentity Pauli observables, Lean 4 proves Jonah's spectral
floor---satisfied minus violated commuting triples is at most $(D-2)|S|^{3/2}/(6\sqrt{D-1})$, forcing
asymptotic violation fraction $1/2$---its quaternionic (Kramers) refinement, five-way saturation
equivalence, and quantum-metric and two-character theorems. Outside the classical families, Lean 4 proves
exact degrees 75 (4 qubits), 480 (5 qubits), 2016 (6 qubits) and 729344 (7 qubits), plus an infinite
non-closed contextual floor-saturating pure-CCZ determinant family $`|\Psi_{3m}\rangle`$ ($m\ge1$), while
ruling out rank-8 nine-qubit forms across 540.3 million cyclic-invariant cases. On classical geometries,
Lean 4 proves exact CSS witnesses, ladders and unconditional bounds $d(W(7,2))\ge1455$ and
$d(Q^+(9,2))\ge6444$, paired with an independent 42-orbit C census and pure-integer dual check
reproducing Jonah's exact triple $(315,1575,6975)$.

We then test Jonah's strict law: on a 71-point section of the real four-qubit quadric, two cospectral
$16\times16$ carriers have $64\times64$ completions with cubic traces 14976 and 15360 and exact global
binary completion minima 368 and 344 (exact gap 24, kernel-certified via pure-integer MET-SDP duals).
Graph constructions over $\mathbb R$, $\mathbb C$ and $\mathbb H$, a cone pair swap and a universal
cubic-trace identity give cospectral carriers with distinct completion eigenvalue multisets in all nine
vertex cases for every $N\ge4$, proving Jonah's Conjecture E. All main theorems (110 newly audited
declarations plus retained audits) are proved in Lean 4 with standard axioms only, with exact checks
through six qubits and Tsotchke demonstrations. The work is AI-assisted and is neither externally peer
reviewed nor a quantum-hardware experiment.

abstract_plain_text:
Spectral methods give rigorous bounds on Pauli contextuality, yet a spectrum need not retain the information needed by a related completion problem. For N qubits, D=2^N, and any set S of nonidentity Pauli observables, Lean 4 proves Jonah's spectral floor -- satisfied minus violated commuting triples is at most (D-2)|S|^(3/2)/(6 sqrt(D-1)), forcing asymptotic violation fraction 1/2 -- its quaternionic (Kramers) refinement, five-way saturation equivalence, and quantum-metric and two-character theorems. Outside the classical families, Lean 4 proves exact degrees 75 (4 qubits), 480 (5 qubits), 2016 (6 qubits) and 729344 (7 qubits), plus an infinite non-closed contextual floor-saturating pure-CCZ determinant family |Psi_{3m}> (m>=1), while ruling out rank-8 nine-qubit forms across 540.3 million cyclic-invariant cases. On classical geometries, Lean 4 proves exact CSS witnesses, ladders and unconditional bounds d(W(7,2))>=1455 and d(Q^+(9,2))>=6444, paired with an independent 42-orbit C census and pure-integer dual check reproducing Jonah's exact triple (315,1575,6975).

We then test Jonah's strict law: on a 71-point section of the real four-qubit quadric, two cospectral 16-by-16 carriers have 64-by-64 completions with cubic traces 14976 and 15360 and exact global binary completion minima 368 and 344 (exact gap 24, kernel-certified via pure-integer MET-SDP duals). Graph constructions over R, C and H, a cone pair swap and a universal cubic-trace identity give cospectral carriers with distinct completion eigenvalue multisets in all nine vertex cases for every N>=4, proving Jonah's Conjecture E. All main theorems (110 newly audited declarations plus retained audits) are proved in Lean 4 with standard axioms only, with exact checks through six qubits and Tsotchke demonstrations. The work is AI-assisted and is neither externally peer reviewed nor a quantum-hardware experiment.
lean_scope: Lean 4.35.0 proves the spectral floor and asymptotic 1/2 limits (Theorem 1, Corollary A), quaternionic/Kramers floor and elliptic quadrics (Theorem 2, Kramers.lean), five-way saturation equivalences and (2^N-1)|S| = square (Theorems 3-4, SaturationTheory.lean), quantum-metric and two-character theorems (Propositions 3, 8, 10, AuditUpgrades.lean), exact finite degrees 75, 480, 2016 and 729344 with kernel-evaluated counts, the infinite non-closed contextual floor-saturating pure-CCZ determinant family |Psi_{3m}> for every m >= 1 directly from the state vector (Theorem 13b, NormPhaseFamily.lean), symplectic transvection invariance, exact CSS witnesses (315, 1575, 6975), double-counting ladders, unconditional Kramers-lifted bounds d(W(7,2)) >= 1455 and d(Q^+(9,2)) >= 6444, Lemmas L1/L4 and master reduction (ExactDegreesN4N5.lean), the four-qubit C3 spectral certificate (42 declarations) and EXACT global binary completion optima min F(sigma_0) = 368 and min F(sigma_1) = 344 with exact gap 24 (Theorem 16'', C3ExactOptima.lean, plus Corollary 16 & Proposition 16'), case C3 for every N >= 4 (CarrierFamily.lean, 74 declarations), the general cone lift and case C11 (Corollary 18), signed-Clifford orbit transport, Lemmas 20-21, Theorem 22, Table 8 character sums, and eigenvalue-multiset Theorem 19 across all nine vertex cases for every N >= 4 (110 audited declarations in VerifyNewFormalizations.lean including 10 existential non-vacuity witnesses in NonVacuity.lean, strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], independently checked across multiple Lean kernels via lake comparator --paranoid (Challenge.lean/Solution.lean), Batteries linted, and cross-checked in a 70-declaration Lean Blueprint). Remaining outside Lean: state-to-mask identifications of finite Table 1 rows other than |Psi_{3m}>, Propositions 4, 6, 9, 11, Theorems 12-13 enumerations, the 540.3M-form N=9 rank-8 cyclic census, the 42-orbit W(5,2) census and 42 pure-integer certificates reproducing Jonah [J1] (verified independently in C/Python with zero floating point), printed C3 factorizations and spherical gap 32, and the single-orbit group-transitivity classification of Jonah [J3, Theorem B4].
